summary: Burglary charges filed in a Cantwell trespass arrest, four overnight DUI arrests by troopers, two city arrests including a felony assault, and a Delta Junction terroristic-threatening case with hearings set in Fairbanks. The court's dispositions report has not updated since Sep. 21.

entries.title: Felony burglary charges filed after Cantwell trespass arrest
body: Krista Marie Zappone faces six counts, all dated Sep. 25: criminal trespass in the first degree at Denali National Park (Class A misdemeanor); theft in the fourth degree (Class B misdemeanor); two counts of violating conditions of release (Class B misdemeanors); burglary in the first degree, in a dwelling (Class B felony); and burglary in the second degree (Class C felony), all at Cantwell.

The trooper dispatch posted Sep. 26 listed seven counts with no felony. The court filing adds both burglary charges. Arraignment was held Sep. 26; a preliminary hearing is set for Oct. 6 at 3:15 p.m. in Fairbanks. The same counts also appear in the court's weekly report under 4FA-26-01933CR, which CourtView does not return.

entries.title: Troopers make four DUI arrests overnight, one at .331 breath alcohol
body: Fairbanks, 6:18 p.m.: Anthony Burton was stopped after pulling out of a parking lot at high speed and arrested for DUI. He provided a breath sample of .331, requested an independent blood test, and was remanded to Fairbanks Correctional Center.
Goldstream Road, 9:22 p.m.: Airion Baumgartner, 25, of Fairbanks, was arrested for DUI and refusal to submit to a breath test after failing to slow when passing troopers on a call. Remanded to FCC.
Delta Junction, 11:03 p.m.: Sara Parlin, 30, of Delta Junction, was arrested for DUI after a traffic stop and released on her own recognizance.
Delta Junction, Sep. 24 (posted Sep. 27): Roman Malyk was arrested for DUI and driving with a revoked license following a REDDI report. Court file 4DJ-26-00057CR.

entries.title: Juveniles identified in vehicle damage to Pearl Creek school field
body: Troopers responded to a report of a vehicle doing donuts on the grass field at Pearl Creek Elementary School. The suspects were identified as juveniles. The investigation is ongoing.

entries.title: Two DUIs, a Parks Highway injury crash and a firearms theft on Sep. 26 dispatch
body: Fairbanks, Sep. 25, 11:05 p.m.: Tariq Eskridge was arrested for DUI and refusal after leaving the Club Soda parking lot without stopping or signaling. Court file 4FA-26-01927CR.
Fairbanks, Sep. 26, 2:16 a.m.: Kimberly Baird was arrested for DUI after leaving the Red Fox bar parking lot without headlights; breath sample .114. Court file 4FA-26-01930CR.

Parks Highway Mile 257, Healy, Sep. 25: A semi-truck struck a car stopped partly in the lane while its driver took a photograph. Troopers said the truck driver fell asleep. Both drivers were cited; all passengers were taken to Fairbanks Memorial Hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.
North Pole: Troopers are investigating a reported violation of an out-of-state domestic violence protective order.
Goldridge area, Fairbanks: Firearms were reported stolen from a residence. A suspect has been identified and charges are being forwarded to the District Attorney.

entries.title: City police arrest two, one on felony assault charge
body: Dateen Duane Arkell, 42, was arrested at 2:02 p.m. near Clay Street and Second Avenue on a charge recorded by police as assault in the third degree, cause injury with a weapon, a felony. No court file had appeared as of the Sep. 26 court report.
Donald Dean Pannick, 70, was arrested at 12:54 a.m. in the 1600 block of East Cowles Street on a charge of harassment in the first degree, a misdemeanor.

entries.title: Theft arrest on Johansen Expressway
body: Vladimir Valentin Kulikovskiy, 39, was arrested on a charge of theft in the fourth degree (under $250), a Class B misdemeanor. The arrest was added to the bulletin two days after the date.

entries.title: Delta Junction terroristic threatening case set for hearings in Fairbanks
body: Pavel Ivanovich Budnik is charged with terroristic threatening in the second degree (Class C felony) and violating conditions of release for a felony (Class A misdemeanor), both dated Sep. 20 at Delta Junction.
A bail hearing is set for Sep. 30 at 3:30 p.m., with preliminary hearings Oct. 1 and Oct. 8, all at the Fairbanks courthouse.

entries.title: Warrant requested in domestic violence assault case
body: Matthew Wayland Mayo Sr. is charged with one count of assault in the fourth degree, domestic-violence related, and four counts of assault when a child is present, all Class A misdemeanors dated Sep. 9. A warrant was requested when charges were filed Sep. 25. No hearing is calendared.

entries.title: Court dispositions report has not updated since Sep. 21
body: The Alaska Court System's criminal dispositions report still carries a Sep. 21 update stamp, six days running. Case outcomes after that date are not yet reflected.
